scope: Five alternating producer process pairs per workload. Command timing is batch means, not frame P95. First application frame uses official boot and launch wall timestamps. Source activation is separate and uses the second public module update with monotonic timestamps; neither is GPU completion or physical display. Main-process CPU excludes child processes. Raw trials and all outliers are retained. Flags require explicit review, not automatic waiver.
